data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 3/3): Partial-state recovery contract — six ensure_* funcs run sequentially. If ensure_bucket succeeds but a later step fails, bucket exists with partial config AND no config-write occurred. Add: (a) write_config_key MUST run IMMEDIATELY AFTER ensure_bucket (not at end), so rerun is idempotent even after partial failure; (b) on any ensure_* failure after ensure_bucket succeeds, exit non-zero with stderr naming failed step + bucket name; (c) document partial-state recovery in script header. Verify: ordering test in task-1 (add t_config_write_runs_after_ensure_bucket_before_other_ensures) AND grep -qE 'partial.state|recovery' on script comments.
